candidates.title: U.S. Agencies Warn Refrigeration Controller Attacks Could Cause Fires and Inventory Losses Nov 09, 2026 Critical Infrastructure / Cyber Attack U.S. government agencies have warned that threat actors are actively targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems globally with an aim to cause service disruptions, fire hazards, and loss of inventory. CISA Flags SonicWall SonicOS MFA Bypass Flaw Amid Reports of Possible Exploitation Nov 09, 2026 Vulnerability / Network Security The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a high-severity vulnerability impacting SonicWall SonicOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities ( KEV ) catalog, following reports that it said may have been exploited in real-world attacks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS score: 7.1 / 7.5), has been described as an authentication reinforcement vulnerability via alternate authentication methods. "An authentication enforcement vulnerability in SonicOS SSL-VPN service may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA)," SonicWall said in a Friday advisory. The company also acknowledged that it "investigated a report indicating potential exploitation of this vulnerability," urging customers to update to the latest version as soon as possible.
